newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PDCP Bank, Asian Bank eye merger.
newsitem.headline: PDCP Bank, Asian Bank eye merger.

text.p: The major shareholders of PDCP Bank and AsianBank have agreed to pursue the merger of both banks, a joint statement on Thursday said.
The statement said major shareholders agreed on the general principles that will govern the merger and the steps necessary to complete the process.
The listed shareholders involved in the transaction are Metro Pacific Corp for PDCP and A. Soriano Corp and Bacnotan Consolidated Industries of the Phinma Group for AsianBank.

"PDCP's extensive branch network and its customer base of retail accounts and small and medium-scale businesses complement AsianBank's strength in investment banking and the capital markets and its focus on corporate accounts," said Carlos Torres, president of PDCP Bank.
Upon the completion of the merger, the bank will have about 6.6 billion pesos in capital and 140 branches.
